reviewed_reader.anchor: Native software and evaluation working successor

scope: Author source, saved-observation, algebra and extracted-text review

evidence.anchor: 175 genuine scholarly PDFs and preserved citation contexts
Current source snapshots and six matched SDK originals
13 scientific, three lifecycle and three adverse cases
Error/identity repair and local/external acceptance plan

findings: Exact response agreement is restricted to the common negotiated request domain and bounded generated cases.
Capability asymmetry, scientific refusal and stored replay corruption are distinct and retained.
SDK validation ownership and complete transport identity are supported by actual source paths.
Error repair, local cases and later owner inputs are proposed; no implementation repair or universal parity is claimed.
All inherited source records, contexts and economic claims remain; no new bank economics or live model claim.
limitations: Bounded generated local stdio observations; no universal parity, HTTP, multi-tenant or newer-protocol qualification.
Stored-replay error attribution remains a known implementation defect; the repair is proposed, not implemented.
Source inspection is static evidence; shared response equality does not establish causal truth, calibration or useful bank precision.
No live model, sibling integration, bank acceptance, independent institutional review or measured ROI is claimed.
Rendered visual acceptance remains open under the inherited exhausted six-image allowance.
